common.notFoundBody: This page doesn't exist or has moved.

errors.forbidden: You don't have permission to do that.
errors.csrf_missing: Your request was blocked. Reload the page and try again.
errors.rate_limited: Too many requests. Wait a minute and try again.
errors.busy: The spreadsheet is busy. Try again in a few seconds.
errors.invalid_link: This sign-in link is invalid, used or expired. Request a new one.
errors.email_taken: That email is already in use.
errors.slug_taken: Another event already uses that URL.
errors.last_owner: The workspace needs at least one active owner.
errors.network: Can't reach the server. Check your connection.
errors.conflict: That value is already in use.
errors.setup_token_invalid: That setup token doesn't match the one in the server log.
errors.sheet_not_connected: Connect a spreadsheet to this event first.
errors.field_locked: People have already registered, so this field's type can't change. Add a new field instead.
errors.builtin_locked: Name and email are built in and can't be removed or retyped.

fieldErrors.invalid_url: Enter a web address starting with https://.
fieldErrors.invalid_slug: Use lowercase letters, numbers and dashes.
fieldErrors.invalid_key: Use lowercase letters, digits and _, starting with a letter (max 40).
fieldErrors.key_taken: Another field already uses this key.
fieldErrors.not_available_yet: Photo and file uploads arrive in a later version.
fieldErrors.reserved_key: This key is reserved; choose another.
fieldErrors.self_reference: A field can't depend on itself.
fieldErrors.invalid_pattern: That pattern isn't a valid regular expression.

login.staffTitle: Sign in to the control panel
login.participantIntro: Enter the email you registered with. We'll send you a link to your pass and schedule.
login.staffIntro: Enter your email and we'll send you a sign-in link. No password needed.
login.sentBody: If {{email}} can sign in, a link is on its way. It works once and expires in 15 minutes. Check your spam folder too.
login.demoBody: Emails are not sent. Request a link, then open the dev mailbox to click it.
login.participantLink: Registered for an event? Open your pass
login.staffLink: Organizer or staff? Sign in here

events.title: Events
events.empty: No events yet. Create one to start taking registrations.
events.noAccess: You haven't been added to any event yet. Ask an admin to give you a role.
events.name: Event name
events.slugHint: Used in the public page address: /e/{{slug}}

event.noActivity: Nothing has happened yet. Scans and admin changes appear here.
event.connectFirst: This event has no spreadsheet yet. Connect one in

participants.title: Participants
participants.search: Search name, email or pass ID
participants.none: No participants yet. They appear here as people register.
participants.name: Name

staff.title: Staff and viewers
staff.intro: Staff scan passes and look people up. Viewers see the dashboard and participant list but can't change anything.
staff.empty: No one has a role in this event yet. Add staff for scanning on the day.
staff.name: Name
staff.removeConfirm: Remove {{name}} from this event? They lose access straight away.
staff.added: Access granted. They can sign in with their email.

users.title: Users
users.intro: People who can sign in to the control panel. Event roles are managed on each event's Staff page.
users.disableConfirm: Disable {{name}}? They're signed out on every device and can't sign in until re-enabled.

settings.title: Workspace
settings.productNameHint: Shown in the header, browser title, emails and passes.
settings.lowContrast: White text on this primary color is below the WCAG AA contrast ratio of 4.5:1. Pick a darker color so buttons stay readable.

form.title: Registration form
form.intro: These fields become the form participants fill in and the columns of the Participants tab. A field's key is its column header and never changes.
form.hideConfirm: Remove “{{label}}” from the form? Its column and data stay in the spreadsheet, and you can restore it.
form.hiddenIntro: Removed fields keep their column and data. Restore one to put it back on the form.
form.label: Label
form.keyHint: The column header in the spreadsheet. It can't change later.

eventSettings.title: Event settings
eventSettings.timeZoneHint: An IANA name such as Asia/Colombo. Times show in this zone.
eventSettings.modeOpen: Open: everyone who registers gets a pass
eventSettings.modeApproval: Approval: an admin approves each registration
eventSettings.capacityHint: Leave empty for no limit. When full, new registrations join the waitlist.
eventSettings.consentHint: Shown above a required checkbox. Changing it starts a new version (current: {{version}}).

connect.title: Connect a spreadsheet
connect.step1: In Google Sheets, create a new, empty spreadsheet for this event.
connect.step2: Share it as Editor with the EventPass service account:
connect.step3: Paste the spreadsheet's link below. EventPass creates every tab.

portal.title: Your events
portal.inactive: This pass isn't valid for entry. Contact the organizers if this is a mistake.
portal.passAlt: Pass for {{name}}, pass ID {{passId}}, with a QR code
portal.showAtEntrance: Show this QR code at the entrance. Turn your screen brightness up.

scan.title: Scanner
scan.comingSoon: Scanning arrives in the next release. Use the participant lookup in the control panel meanwhile.

public.notFound: This event isn't open to the public.
public.fixErrors: Some answers need fixing. They're marked below.
public.consentRequired: You need to agree to register.

reg.not_yet_open: Registration hasn't opened yet. Check back soon.

registered.title: You're registered
registered.body: Your pass for {{event}} is on its way to your inbox.

pending_approval.title: Registration received
pending_approval.body: The organizers of {{event}} will review your registration. You'll get an email when they do.

waitlisted.title: You're on the waitlist
waitlisted.body: {{event}} is full. We'll email you if a spot opens up.

already_registered.title: Check your inbox
already_registered.body: If this email is registered for {{event}}, we've sent a sign-in link to your portal.

public.checkSpam: Can't find the email? Check your spam or promotions folder.

welcome.title: Set up EventPass
welcome.body: This wizard connects Google Sheets and email and creates your owner account. It takes about ten minutes.
welcome.tokenHint: Printed in the server log when EventPass started (look for “setup needed”).

google.title: Connect Google Sheets
google.step1: In Google Cloud, create a project, enable the Google Sheets API and create a service account with a JSON key.
google.step2: Create an empty spreadsheet for the workspace and share it as Editor with the service account's email.
google.step3: Paste the key and the spreadsheet link here.
google.keyHint: It's stored encrypted on the server and never shown again.
google.keyFromEnv: The service account key comes from GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS.
google.sheetHint: EventPass creates its tabs in this spreadsheet.

smtp.title: Connect email
smtp.intro: Passes and sign-in links are sent through your email provider. We'll send a test email.
smtp.gmailHint: For Gmail, turn on 2-Step Verification and create an App Password; use it as the password.
smtp.ok: Test email sent to {{email}}. Check it arrived before continuing.

workspace.title: Workspace and owner
workspace.productNameHint: Shown in the control panel, emails and passes.

done.title: Setup complete
done.body: We sent a sign-in link to {{email}}. Open it to sign in as the owner.
